instruction: Write one coherent paragraph proposing ways to protect local wildlife.
question_text: Explain how communities can protect local wildlife.
sample_answer: Local communities can protect wildlife by preserving habitats and reducing pollution.
ai_grading_rubric: Score 1-10 for relevance, coherence, grammar, and vocabulary.
user_answer: Local communities can protect wildlife by preserving natural habitats. They can also reduce pollution and support conservation programs. These actions help endangered species survive.
